text: Hmm, yeah, I don't think I want to go with the 15-inch one. Honestly, I'd rather not do that if there's another way. Let me think about that one. Maybe I'll just keep the one I have. Yeah, I think I'll just keep my current 17-inch i5 laptop. No worries on the exchange.
zh: 嗯，是的，我不想去15英寸的那款。老实说，如果还有其他办法的话，我宁愿不这么做。让我想想那个。也许我就留着我现在这个吧。是的，我想我就保留我现在的17英寸i5笔记本电脑。交换就不必了。
